title: 가입 주별 첫 7일 활성화 퍼널
question: 가입자는 첫 7일 동안 어디서 멈추나?
sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT signup_week AS cohort, board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALL', board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
)
SELECT cohort, 1 AS step_no, '가입' AS step_name, count(*) AS reached, 0 AS unknown, count(*) AS eligible FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 2, '게시판 참여', sum(board_state = 'reached'), 0, count(*) FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 3, '다른 회원과 연결', sum(connected_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(board_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 4, '첫 글', sum(post_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(connected_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 5, '반응 받음', sum(received_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(post_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort, step_no
definition: 가입 후 7일이 지난 회원 (가입 주 = 월요일 시작)
가입 → 게시판 참여 → 다른 회원과 같은 게시판 → 첫 글 → 내 글에 다른 회원의 댓글·공감
모든 단계는 가입 후 7일 안, 앞 단계 이후
caveats: 읽기만 하는 회원은 활동으로 잡히지 않습니다
